purpose: Four additional hero choices with a restrained masculine lean, as requested by the user; not a replacement or a new global style reference.

portraits.label: Железный
portraits.appearance: Northern European appearance; light cool beige skin, grey eyes, slightly wide gently angular jaw and a defined but not oversized chin, straight natural eyebrows, long straight nose with a tiny asymmetry. Short ash-brown hair, irregular textured crop swept loosely back, open forehead. A couple of shallow healed acne marks. Balanced soft mouth and calm eyes keep the masculine lean gentle.
portraits.clothing: Plain charcoal wool tunic, low narrow standing collar with an off-center short opening and one visible flat seam. No scarf, no layered neck wrap.
portraits.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original playable adult human HERO portrait for Heroes of Orvesk. Single standalone opaque PNG, 1024x1536, vertical 2:3. This is a new individual, not an edit and not a grid.

SPECIFIC USER DIRECTION FOR THIS BATCH: slightly MORE MASCULINE-LEANING than our earlier soft androgynous heroes, while retaining an androgynous character. Achieve this with a modestly firmer jaw/chin, straighter stronger eyebrows, grounded cheek planes and mature ordinary facial proportions. Soft natural details remain. The change should be visible but restrained: not a hypermasculine warrior, not a giant square jaw, not a thick muscular neck, not a glamour model. No beard, moustache, stubble shadow, makeup, styled lashes, sexualization or exaggerated Adam's apple. Fully grown, age accurate, unmistakably human, no elf ears. Do not use femininely sculpted glamour lips or a youthful fashion-model face by default. Give an ordinary individual with imperfections, not a stock handsome face.

ART DIRECTION: dark gothic painted fantasy illustration. Strong sculpturally modelled volume and deep chiaroscuro, matte painted tonal planes. Fine broken dry-brush strokes and scumbled transitions follow anatomy; no photographic pore detail and no uniform noise overlay. Selective clarity on face and eyes; hair grouped into distinct locks/masses rather than every strand; fabric large angular broken folds with worn edges. Restrained graphite/grey-brown/old linen palette and natural skin undertones. No photo, photorealism, smooth 3D or CGI, glossy/waxy skin, beauty retouch, heavy impasto, anime, cartoon, low-poly.
One directional light from ABOVE FRONT IMAGE LEFT, regardless of the gaze. Brightest face; readable deep shadows; outer shoulders and dark clothing recede into opaque near-black charcoal background. No scenery, colored studio lights, neon, magical eyes or full rim glow.

COMPOSITION for both rectangle and round avatar: THREE-QUARTER HEAD FACING AND LOOKING TO IMAGE RIGHT, BOTH EYES VISIBLE. Entire head, hair and upper shoulders on canvas; natural anatomy. Main head mass centered at X=50% of width (47–53%), about70% canvas width (64–76%). Dark headroom target12% height: main top of hair/head near y=184px, acceptable154–215px. Mean eye line about38% height, y=584px, acceptable553–614px. Bottom of chin near64%, y=983px, acceptable937–1029px. Do not stretch anatomy to fit numbers; scale and place the whole head. Do not show waist or excessive torso. Keep the face dominant.
